title: Kessler Care Fleet Addendum Tenure Credit Schedule
content:
**Fleet tenure credit.** On a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan addendum of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans, the fleet tenure credit counts the whole months from the opening date of the customer's service account to the pricing date, the day the addendum is signed. The opening date is the one recorded on the account in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records.

| Whole months since the service account opened | Fleet tenure credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 96 or more | 30.00 |
| 36 or more, but fewer than 96 | 15.00 |
| Fewer than 36 | None |

**Edges.** At exactly 96 whole months the credit is 30.00, and at 95 it is 15.00. At exactly 36 whole months it is 15.00, and at 35 there is none.

**Counting whole months (hypothetical dates).** An account opened on 20 March counts 36 whole months on 20 March three years later. On 19 March of that year it counts 35.
